scope: Source and product workflow audit plus explicitly recorded local validation; not production certification

statusContract.supported: Implemented with evidence for the named slice only
statusContract.partial: Some implementation or validation exists; acceptance is not closed
statusContract.planned: Remaining implementation or execution is scheduled, not delivered
statusContract.not_planned: Explicitly outside the current product contract

models.maturity: Graph Beta scope; production gates not passed

gaps.finding: Latest seven scheduled runs failed on pre-fix startup; no post-fix Parity observed. Post-fix main CI built but tests failed; authenticated logs unavailable
gaps.acceptance: Source-generated-only Server startup and MCP calls; repaired light/full parity then seven scheduled runs meeting the existing verifier

gaps.finding: Foreground automatic sampling moved to bounded background; first-N sampling and page costs still biased
gaps.acceptance: No foreground sample, bounded maintenance and lifecycle; representative samples, accurate estimated/actual rows, parameter-sensitive plans and measured mixed-workload tail latency

gaps.finding: Transaction batching/context/NDJSON corrected; server and browser still materialize entire results
gaps.acceptance: Real commit/error/rollback journey; bounded preview or end-to-end streaming, explicit truncation, cancellation and large-result heap/first-row evidence

gaps.finding: Cross-keyspace power-loss atomic transactions are not implemented by light transaction compensation
gaps.acceptance: Keep limitation in public contracts; any future crash-atomic transaction design requires a separate approved storage and recovery plan

gaps.finding: Typed write/query and backpressure/retry/error workflow remains incomplete
gaps.acceptance: Embedded/remote equivalent batch writer, bounded buffers, precision/schema rejection, safe retry, drain and per-point error evidence

gaps.finding: Single-key atomic Core/REST/Frame/SDK/Web contract implemented and locally verified; Native AOT process reopen and desktop/mobile real-server journeys passed, separate from remote Parity and production gates
gaps.acceptance: REST/Frame/SDK matching TTL/NX/XX/return values/version errors and cancellation; zero AOT warnings; no client-side read-then-write emulation

gaps.finding: Atomic single-key closure does not include large-keyspace async cursor, pipeline or diagnostics
gaps.acceptance: Bounded async cursor, pipeline/batch per-item outcomes, cancellation/backpressure, hot-key/expiry/capacity diagnostics and large-keyspace evidence

gaps.finding: High-level search/facets/server highlight/settings/relevance and rebuild progress remain partial
gaps.acceptance: Typed request reuses authoritative document and existing index; fixed CJK corpus, stable paging, matched offsets, relevance explanation and rebuild failure visibility

gaps.finding: Metadata prefilter reduces distances, but generic scan and sorting are still materialized; no general filtered ANN
gaps.acceptance: Bounded scan/Top-K, cancellation, differential exact oracle and measured distance/heap/Recall@K across filter selectivity; explain actual ANN/fallback backend

gaps.finding: vector_search WHERE preserves existing non-standard SQL NULL equality/NOT behavior
gaps.acceptance: Freeze documented NULL contract and compare vector/hybrid/document with shared SQL truth tables before changing semantics; preserve explicit compatibility boundary

gaps.finding: Bounded ordinal listing uses derived rows in the existing object metadata KV/WAL, incremental ordered overlays, delimiter seeks and an explicit physical-candidate budget; upgrade/rebuild and fixed-hardware costs are separately documented
gaps.acceptance: Cost bounded by page candidates, raw-key ordinal order including Unicode and encoded keys; version/delete/delimiter/continuation differential tests; cancellation/reopen and interrupted derived-index rebuild; budget exhaustion never returns a partial page

gaps.finding: Multipart primitives exist, complete transfer manager/resume/checksum workflow does not
gaps.acceptance: Large streaming upload/download, bounded concurrency, interrupted resume, checksums, safe retry, per-object errors, cancel cleanup and dry-run sync

gaps.finding: ACK maximum overflow and returned/actual offset mismatch corrected locally
gaps.acceptance: Old/duplicate/max/empty/retention/group/negative boundaries, actual log decoding and reopen in directory/single-file modes; covered by local Core run

gaps.finding: Server MQ is instance-scoped outside database backup
gaps.acceptance: Explicit instance snapshot/drain/flush and manifest contract; restore messages, headers, offsets, consumer groups, retention and subsequent writes without mixing other databases into a single-db archive

gaps.finding: Consumer drain/backpressure and delivery failure governance are incomplete
gaps.acceptance: Manual/auto ACK, nack/redelivery/max delivery/DLQ and dedupe window with restart tests; default durability explicit, no unsupported exactly-once claim

gaps.finding: SQL, Graph and KV stale target/approval and response isolation fixed; KV has real-server desktop/mobile evidence; other workbenches still need audit
gaps.acceptance: Delayed responses and database/connection/token/unmount changes cannot redirect writes or replace current data; real Server integration and remaining model workbenches covered

gaps.finding: VS Code lacks native Graph Explorer and minimal graph operations
gaps.acceptance: Discover/schema/bounded browse/open SQL and stable permission/not-found/budget errors against same real fixture as Web/SDK

gaps.finding: Graph Beta implementation does not close production gates
gaps.acceptance: Prerequisite gates first, then fixed hardware, external parity/LDBC/Graphalytics subsets, Couplet, crash/backup/native AOT and 168-hour evidence

gaps.finding: Real provider/model evidence, Agent Framework boundary, RAG durable writer/resume/index apply remain open
gaps.acceptance: Pinned actual model/tokenizer/corpus/license and quality/latency/cost evidence; hash fallback never counted as semantics; durable ingestion retry/resume/deletion and rollback journey

gaps.finding: Source/entry catalogue and local atomic KV Native AOT reopen/Web journeys exist; nine-model backup, recovery and host journeys not all executed
gaps.acceptance: One real model-native journey each across embedded/server/client, permissions/paging/cancel/failure/reopen/backup; mock, WebView2 installation and real server evidence separated

gaps.finding: Fixed target hardware and complete nine-domain cold/warm/soak evidence absent
gaps.acceptance: Default full profiles on fixed x64/ARM64 with commit, disk, durability, raw latency/throughput/memory/I/O and correctness; no quick/downscaled substitute
